scenarios.title: Clean install with no PostgreSQL
scenarios.mechanism: Runner PostgreSQL service deleted and its cluster moved away; port 5432 free; real EDB installed by the bundle.

scenarios.title: Clean install while outbound Internet is blocked
scenarios.mechanism: Windows Firewall outbound block to Internet; an outbound TCP probe must fail before setup runs.

scenarios.title: Upgrade from N-1 to N
scenarios.mechanism: Install the pinned N-1 baseline, seed sentinels, run the tested N artifact.

scenarios.title: Upgrade from N-2 to N
scenarios.mechanism: Install the pinned N-2 baseline, seed sentinels, run the tested N artifact.

scenarios.title: Same-version reinstall
scenarios.mechanism: Install N, seed, run the identical N artifact again.

scenarios.title: Repair from Add/Remove Programs
scenarios.mechanism: Delete an installed file, run the ARP-registered cached bundle with /repair.

scenarios.title: Legacy PostgreSQL on port 5442 without pg_super.bin
scenarios.mechanism: Real EDB cluster moved to port 5442 and pg_super.bin removed (legacy layout), then run N.

scenarios.title: Managed PostgreSQL with pg_super.bin
scenarios.mechanism: RoofSpan-managed EDB service plus DPAPI pg_super.bin present; prep must take the managed path.

scenarios.title: PostgreSQL service registered but stopped
scenarios.mechanism: RoofSpanPostgreSQL and Office services stopped before running N.

scenarios.title: Unrelated process using port 5432
scenarios.mechanism: A non-PostgreSQL TCP listener owns 0.0.0.0:5432 before a clean install.

scenarios.title: Existing unrelated PostgreSQL service
scenarios.mechanism: A real, running, non-RoofSpan PostgreSQL service with its own sentinel database owns 5432.

scenarios.title: Stale RoofSpan configuration with no service and no cluster
scenarios.mechanism: Leftover roofspan.env + pg_super.bin, no PostgreSQL service or data directory.

scenarios.title: Stale configuration with a real database cluster
scenarios.mechanism: Configuration and a real EDB data directory remain but the RoofSpanPostgreSQL service is unregistered.

scenarios.title: PostgreSQL in a non-default binary and data location
scenarios.mechanism: Real EDB installed by the bundle is relocated to D:\rs-custom\{bin,data} and re-registered, then run N.

scenarios.title: Corrupt saved credential
scenarios.mechanism: pg_super.bin replaced with random bytes; it must never be silently overwritten.

scenarios.title: Insufficient backup disk space
scenarios.mechanism: A 64 MB NTFS VHDX is mounted at ProgramData\RoofSpan\upgrade-backups.

scenarios.title: pg_dump failure
scenarios.mechanism: Deny-execute ACE for Everyone on the service's pg_dump.exe (security software blocking the tool).

scenarios.title: Backup verification failure
scenarios.mechanism: pg_dump works; deny-execute ACE on pg_restore.exe makes archive verification fail.

scenarios.title: Installer failure after backup
scenarios.mechanism: Deny write/delete ACE on an installed N-1 service executable makes the N MSI fail (1603) after BACKUP_VERIFIED.

scenarios.title: Migration failure before any revision is applied
scenarios.mechanism: Armed at INSTALLING (after the verified backup): event trigger + alembic_version trigger raise on the first DDL or revision write by the application role.

scenarios.title: Migration failure after a partial schema change
scenarios.mechanism: Armed at INSTALLING: the alembic_version trigger raises only when the final head is written, after DDL ran (count recorded in migrate.log).

scenarios.title: Backend startup failure after migration
scenarios.mechanism: An exclusive listener owns 0.0.0.0:8001 until the coordinator reaches RESTORING.

scenarios.title: Health-check failure after services start
scenarios.mechanism: While HEALTH_CHECKING, the Relay connector is stopped whenever it is running (it must stay up 15 s).

scenarios.title: Database restore failure
scenarios.mechanism: Health failure forces recovery; pg_restore.exe is deny-execute from INSTALLING onward.

scenarios.title: Interrupted upgrade followed by retry
scenarios.mechanism: roofspan-upgrade.exe and Burn are killed at INSTALLING (simulated power loss); the same N artifact is run again.

scenarios.title: Pending Windows reboot
scenarios.mechanism: PendingFileRenameOperations and CBS RebootPending markers present before a clean install.

scenarios.title: Silent installation
scenarios.mechanism: /quiet /norestart from a path containing spaces; no reboot, no lingering setup process.

scenarios.title: Installation approved through UAC by a different administrator
scenarios.mechanism: Interactive standard user session; setup elevated with a separate local administrator credential.

scenarios.title: Low-resource Windows VM with a realistically sized database
scenarios.mechanism: VM with <= 4 GB RAM and <= 2 vCPU; N-1 seeded with a multi-GB database, then upgraded to N.

scenarios.title: Uninstall followed by reinstall with retained customer data
scenarios.mechanism: ARP quiet uninstall of the bundle (PostgreSQL is permanent), then reinstall N.

scenarios.title: WebView2 genuinely absent, Internet blocked, embedded WebView2 installs and the shell opens
scenarios.mechanism: Disposable VM image without WebView2; outbound blocked; only RoofSpanSetup.exe present.
